compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Twelve `infra/scripts` files contain audited repeated, historical, obvious, or stale prose. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@d6669496cae4`; this includes the current unclamped `pct_of_cap` contract in `observability.sh`. Operational, security, and recovery contracts must remain explicit.

## Approach
Condense only anchored standalone comments and blank lines. Preserve every executable/configuration line byte-for-byte. Bind each policy directive to its following executable line and preserve both text and placement.

Use a before/final Git comparison whose only ignored lines match `^([[:space:]]*#[^!].*|[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*|[[:space:]]*)$`; do not ignore semicolon or HTML-shaped lines. The anti-vacuity census is 12 shebangs, one SC2016 directive, two gitleaks allowances, five `mechanism-ok` markers (all in `observability.sh`), and no tickets-boundary/raw-git directives.

## Scope
- `autodeploy.sh` — header; marker/backoff/tunable declarations; contracts adjoining marker, bot health/disposition, log capture, Docker/disk-pressure helpers, and `mcp_*` helpers; orchestration sections through the component-marker footer. Retain independent markers/backoffs, no incomplete advancement, bounded resources/drain, secrets-before-start, candidate validation, exact nginx rollback, observability/certbot deployment, and distinct deploy/detect triggers.
- `bootstrap-gerrit-admin.sh` — header, dev-login account creation, shard/ref construction, fetch-or-orphan body, and final restart. Retain pre-OAuth bootstrap, idempotent key installation, account checks, and public `ADMIN_PUBKEY`.
- `compose-up.sh` — header; site/volume enumeration; four cap installers; site, scratch, plugin/hook, OAuth, materializer, and final compose-up blocks. Preserve only the contract this file carries: the installed reaper can remove EXITED containers, and a host without one has a capacity problem. Grace windows, protected labels/names, force removal, and volume handling belong to separately tracked container-cap.sh, not this leaf. Retain parent-only gate-scratch and nonfatal installer/materializer postures.
- `config-check.sh` — header, YAML check, volume extractors/comparison, both negative self-tests, and real check. Retain daemon-independent validation and loud empty-enumeration failure.
- `fetch-secrets.sh` — header mapping; required/optional readers and ordering; PAT fallback; authorship/op-cert files; static-token JSON; Jira degradation; generated env. Retain blank-key semantics, atomic permissioned writes, nonlogging, and gitleaks directives; do not call `MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY` a current verdict signer.
- `install-autodeploy.sh` and `install-certbot-timer.sh` — headers and numbered installation sections. Retain idempotence, mirror/bootstrap, disabled timer, host-nginx/dnf/venv fallbacks, HTTP-01 webroot, renewal/reload cadence, and arguments.
- `materialize-mcp-upstream.sh` — header and numbered/only-if-absent/reload sections. Retain that nginx requires the installed include to supply at least one `server` line: the script checks the seed, copies only when the target is absent, and optionally reloads. Do not claim validation of an existing target or atomic replacement.
- `materialize-opcert-guard.sh` — header and numbered/only-if-absent/reload sections. Retain raw guard handling, `umask 077`, unrelated env entries, atomic env replacement, direct nginx-map write, deny-all fallback, brief rotation 403, and the application header check.
- `mcp-entrypoint.sh` — header/config; safe-clear helpers; inode-lock contract; tracker/code clone; ensure/provision path; provision-only/background/PID-1 footer. Retain asynchronous convergence, safe clearing, double-checks, blobless clone, URL-scoped credentials, PID-1 `exec`, and shellcheck directive.
- `observability.sh` — metric catalog; numbered sections; bounded journal helpers; the comment bound to `pct_of_cap`; `docker_du_census`, `docker_ledger_bytes`, marker publishing, and final exit. Retain one `docker system df` format/census; SI/binary parsing; four-known-row total; unknown-row ignore; known-size parse failure; `-1` sentinels; percentage stripping; `read` rather than `set --`; and independent total, percentage, reclaimable, reaper, and quota publications. `pct_of_cap` must remain unclamped because budget metrics must expose values above 100 when a best-effort cap is exceeded; CloudWatch's `Percent` unit is a label, while byte gauges preserve magnitude. Retain bounded probes, MCP 401 health, publish-before-cursor, mirror failure `1`, intentional fail-safe values, and final exit `0`.
- `reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` — header, identity, deferred clone, embedded-Python epoch reconciliation, and ensure-registry. Retain durable setup, merge-as-union, guarded epoch adoption, and no moving-ref reset/discard.

Consumers include systemd, deployment/config gates, nginx, containers, CloudWatch alarms, security checks, and operators. `compose-up.sh` is an autodeploy detect-only materializer path; `observability.sh` is reinstalled through `OBS_PATHS` and feeds container alarms. `container-cap.sh` is outside this parent cohort and is tracked separately.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only anchored standalone comments or blank lines change.
- [ ] Executable and configuration lines remain byte-identical.
- [ ] Every directive remains byte-identical and bound to the same following statement.
- [ ] Each Scope constraint has a cited PASS row in the independent semantic matrix.
- [ ] Each consumer contract has a cited PASS row in the independent semantic matrix.
- [ ] Each edited block has a cited `bloat-removal=PASS` row and is shorter.
- [ ] The content guard and focused non-live checks pass.
- [ ] Path-scoped `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Scoped worktree-venv lint/typecheck checks and Gerrit CI pass.
- [ ] Missing or failing matrix rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the corrected executable-line/directive guards, ShellCheck policy, config self-tests, focused autodeploy/MCP/observability/reviewbot suites, path-scoped diff check, scoped lint/typecheck checks, and Gerrit CI. A non-author reviewer posts the leaf-linked matrix with immutable before/final citations; it is authoritative for prose quality.

rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import re, subprocess, sys
pat = re.compile(r"^\s*#\s*(?:!|shellcheck\b|gitleaks:|tickets-boundary-ok:|raw-git-ok:|mechanism-ok:|pragma:|noqa\b|type:\s*ignore\b)", re.I)
def pairs(ref, path):
    lines = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{path}"], text=True).splitlines()
    out = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not pat.search(line):
            continue
        nxt = next((candidate for candidate in lines[i + 1:] if candidate.strip() and not candidate.lstrip().startswith("#")), "<EOF>")
        out.append((line, nxt))
    return out
bad = [path for path in sys.argv[1:] if pairs("HEAD^", path) != pairs("HEAD", path)]
assert not bad, f"directive/shebang text or placement changed: {bad}"' infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh infra/scripts/bootstrap-gerrit-admin.sh infra/scripts/compose-up.sh infra/scripts/config-check.sh infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh infra/scripts/install-autodeploy.sh infra/scripts/install-certbot-timer.sh infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh infra/scripts/materialize-opcert-guard.sh infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh infra/scripts/observability.sh infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh
